steps: Check the restricted list below, then open www.42.space . The docs are at docs.42.space. Ignore other domains.
Sign in with an email address or an existing wallet, and use the same method each time. A referral code is optional: you can choose "or, skip to enter app".
Fund your account with USDT: "make sure to only send USDT on BSC to the wallet address." Or use the swap option, where "All tokens will be swapped and bridged to USDT on Binance Smart Chain (BSC)."
After each Wednesday close, check the Points page. Claim winning positions from your portfolio once a market resolves.
what: No 42 airdrop or token is announced. Its event-trading app on BNB Chain shares a weekly pool of 42 Points by trading volume. How it works, fees and risks.
behind: The terms form "a legally binding agreement between you and Deep Thought Labs Inc." They don't say where the company is registered, and disputes go to arbitration in Singapore under English law. No official 42 page names the team. Alkimiya raised $7.2 million in 2023 in a round led by 1kx and Castle Island Ventures, The Block reported, and its founders were Ricardo Grobel and Leo Zhang. No 42 page
costs: There is no free route. The fee page puts the 42 app's total at 2.0% per trade, 1.0% to the protocol and 1.0% to the app, though its own worked example uses 1.4%. The fee is charged when you buy and again when you sell. Sells also pay a redemption tax that rises as the market nears its result. Blitz charges 1.6% in total, and its "positions cannot be sold".
